title: (0Day) Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Monitoring Expert GetTgmlContent Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Monitoring Expert. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the GetTgmlContent method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of LOCAL SERVICE.
